definitions.name: L2B.SUM
definitions.note: Vector of numbers to its sum (0 for empty).

definitions.name: L2B.GSUM
definitions.body: GROUP 'ZG' BIND ZG KEYS ZG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys-Vector values-Vector to a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: L2B.LEDGER
definitions.body: 'ZE' BIND ZE [ 0 GET ] MAP ZE [ 1 GET ] MAP L2B.GSUM
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] entries to a Record name -> sum of amounts.

definitions.name: L2B.JOINSP
definitions.note: Vector of Strings joined with single spaces.

definitions.name: L2B.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'ZC' BIND ZC 0 GET UPPER 1 COLLECT ZC 1 DROP CONCAT JOIN
definitions.note: A word to first letter upper case, rest lower case.

definitions.name: L2B.DIVS
definitions.body: 'ZN' BIND 1 ZN RANGE [ 'ZJ' BIND ZN ZN ZJ DIV FLOOR ZJ MUL SUB 0 GT NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Positive integer to Vector of its positive divisors, ascending.

definitions.name: L2B.CSTEP
definitions.body: 'ZX' BIND 1 ZX 3 MUL 1 ADD ZX 2 DIV ZX ZX 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 GT SELECT ZX 1 EQ SELECT

definitions.name: L2B.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'ZS' BIND ZS LENGTH 'ZL' BIND ZS ZL 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET ZS ZL 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty numeric Vector.

definitions.name: L2B.ABS
definitions.note: Absolute value of a number or Vector (lane-wise).

definitions.name: L2B.MEAN
definitions.body: 'ZV' BIND ZV L2B.SUM ZV LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty numeric Vector, a bare scalar.

definitions.name: L2B.DEV
definitions.note: Vector of each number minus the mean.

definitions.name: L2B.VAR
definitions.body: L2B.DEV 'ZD' BIND ZD ZD MUL L2B.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance of a numeric Vector.

definitions.name: L2B.PRICE
definitions.body: 'ZP' BIND ZP 'price' GET 'ZQ' BIND 0 ZQ ZQ NIL? SELECT
definitions.note: Order Record to its price, 0 when absent.

definitions.name: L2B.LINE
definitions.body: 'ZO' BIND ZO 'qty' GET ZO L2B.PRICE MUL
definitions.note: Order Record to qty times price (0 when unpriced).

definitions.name: L2B.ORDERS
definitions.note: JSON String to the Vector of order Records.

definitions.name: L2B.REVENUE
definitions.note: JSON orders String to total revenue.
